svg.text: Key rules — Yazaki cable map verified Sep 2026 + NODE3_DEFINITIVE.md §5–§7:
• CAN-B (purple) Pack 1 ONLY: Pin 4 CANL [Grey] → LilyGo CAN-B L · Pin 5 CANH [Brown] → LilyGo CAN-B H. CAN-A (green, MCP2515) → FoxESS BAT CAN direct.
• Pin 2 is IGN +12V [Yel/Grn] — NOT GND. Both Pin 1 [Red,BAT] AND Pin 2 [Yel/Grn,IGN] must be powered for BMS to wake and close contactors. Wire BOTH from PIN1/IGN BUS via E-stop.
• GND = Yazaki Pins 10/11 [Black]. Also to GND BUS: Pin 8 [Blue]=CT_PRE−, Pin 16 [Green]=CT_POS−, Pin 19 [White]=CT_NEG−. Use matching wire colours throughout.
• Precharge: Pin 7 CT_PRE+ [Cyan] ← SSR Ch1 [IO21]. +Cont: Pin 15 CT_POS+ [Purple] ← SSR Ch2 [IO48]. −Cont: Pin 18 CT_NEG+ [Orange] ← SSR Ch3 [IO17]. Identical all 3 packs.
• Waveshare 2-CH CAN HAT on Pi GPIO (OPTIONAL monitoring only): Pack 2 Pins 4/5 → Waveshare Ch1 · Pack 3 Pins 4/5 → Waveshare Ch2. 120Ω at Pi end each channel. NOT in DALA path.
• No Waveshare in DALA path. T-2CAN galvanically isolated on both channels natively. CAN-B: 1× 120Ω at LilyGo (BMS self-terminates). CAN-A: 120Ω LilyGo + 120Ω FoxESS. 3 total.
• GPIO: IO21(Row10)→SSR Ch1/precharge · IO48(Row9)→SSR Ch2/+cont · IO17(Row11)→SSR Ch3/−cont · GND(Row12). Underside 26-pin 2.54mm header right column.
• Pi 4B: JZK USB-RS485 → /dev/ttyUSB0 → FoxESS RS485 COM port (Modbus RTU). Separate from BAT CAN. Pi and LilyGo are independent — both talk to FoxESS simultaneously.
• Bench-test: 12V on Pins 1 AND 2, SSR OUTs with DMM, LilyGo web UI shows Pack 1 BMS data (CAN-B active). Do this BEFORE inserting any SDP. See NODE3_DEFINITIVE.md §8.
